title: Inversión tras expresiones negativas/restrictivas
summary: Tras Never, Rarely, Seldom, Hardly...when, No sooner...than, Not only, Under no circumstances, Only then/after, Little, etc. al inicio de la frase, el auxiliar va antes del sujeto (como en una pregunta).
examples: Not only did the valve fail, but the alarm also remained silent.
Under no circumstances should operators bypass the interlock.
No sooner had the suspect left than the officers arrived.

title: Condicionales mixtas y alternativas a 'if'
summary: Mezclan tiempos (pasado irreal → presente: If we had invested, we would be...). Alternativas formales: Should you need..., Had they known..., Were it not for..., Provided/Providing that, As long as, Unless, But for, Otherwise.
examples: Had the inspection been carried out, the leak would have been detected.
Were it not for the backup generator, the plant would be offline now.
But for her testimony, the case would have collapsed.

title: Pasiva y pasiva impersonal
summary: be + participio. Impersonal: It is said/believed/thought that... o Sujeto + is said to + infinitivo (to have + participio para pasado). Muy habitual en informes técnicos y policiales.
examples: The suspect is believed to have fled the country.
It is estimated that emissions will fall by 30%.
The turbines are being inspected as we speak.

title: Causativa: have/get something done
summary: have/get + objeto + participio cuando otra persona hace la acción por nosotros. 'get' es más informal o implica esfuerzo.
examples: We had the boiler serviced last week.
She finally got her report approved.

title: Wish / If only / It's (high) time / would rather
summary: wish + pasado (presente irreal), wish + past perfect (pasado), wish + would (quejas sobre otros). It's high time + pasado. I'd rather you + pasado.
examples: I wish I had taken the job.
It's high time the council upgraded the network.
I'd rather you didn't mention it.

title: Modales de deducción y especulación
summary: must/can't/might/could + infinitivo (presente) o + have + participio (pasado). needn't have (hecho innecesario) vs didn't need to (no era necesario, quizás no se hizo).
examples: The fuse must have blown.
He can't have been at the scene; he was on duty elsewhere.
You needn't have brought the documents.

title: Oraciones de relativo y reducidas
summary: Especificativas (sin comas) vs explicativas (con comas, no admiten 'that'). Preposición + whom/which en registro formal. Reducciones con participio: The man arrested yesterday...
examples: The engineer to whom I spoke was very helpful.
The pipeline, which was built in 1980, needs replacing.
Vehicles parked on the hard shoulder will be removed.

title: Oraciones escindidas (cleft sentences)
summary: Para enfatizar: It is/was X that/who... ; What + cláusula + is/was... ; All (that) I need is...; The reason why... is that...
examples: It was the night shift that noticed the anomaly.
What concerns us most is the lack of maintenance.
All we need is a clear procedure.

title: Gerundio vs infinitivo
summary: Algunos verbos cambian de significado: remember/forget/stop/try/regret/go on/mean + -ing vs + to. Tras preposiciones siempre -ing (look forward to + -ing, object to + -ing, be used to + -ing).
examples: I regret to inform you that...
We stopped to check the pressure. / We stopped checking.
I'm not used to working night shifts.

title: Artículos y determinantes
summary: Sin artículo con sustantivos incontables/plurales en sentido general. 'the' con referencias específicas, únicas o ya mencionadas. Expresiones fijas: on the whole, by the way, at a loss, in charge of.
examples: Safety is everyone's responsibility.
The safety of the workers was compromised.

title: Conectores de contraste y concesión
summary: although/though/even though + oración; despite/in spite of + sustantivo o -ing; however/nevertheless/nonetheless entre oraciones; whereas/while para contraste; much as / albeit (formal).
examples: Despite having been warned, they continued.
Much as I admire the proposal, it is too costly.
The system worked, albeit slowly.

title: Causa, consecuencia y finalidad
summary: owing to / due to / on account of + sustantivo; as / since + oración; hence / thus / consequently / therefore; so as to / in order to / so that; lest (formal).
examples: Owing to the strike, production was halted.
The road was closed so as to preserve evidence.

title: Cuantificadores y expresiones de cantidad
summary: few/a few, little/a little, hardly any, the vast majority of, a great deal of (incontables), a large number of (contables), neither/either/both/none of.
examples: Few complaints were received, which was a relief.
A great deal of energy is wasted through leaks.

title: Verbos de estilo indirecto
summary: Patrones: accuse sb of -ing, deny -ing, admit (to) -ing, insist on -ing, warn sb (not) to, urge sb to, suggest -ing / that sb (should) do, blame sb for, object to -ing.
examples: The driver denied having exceeded the speed limit.
The inspector urged the company to review its procedures.

title: Comparaciones avanzadas
summary: the more..., the more...; nowhere near as / not nearly as; by far the + superlativo; considerably/marginally + comparativo; no sooner; as + adj + as can be.
examples: The sooner we act, the lower the cost.
This method is nowhere near as efficient as the old one.

title: Phrasal verbs
summary: Verbo + partícula con significado a menudo idiomático. En Use of English Part 1 y 4 suelen aparecer: come up with, put off, carry out, call off, rule out, look into, bring about, set up, phase out, break down.
examples: The police are looking into the complaint.
The company plans to phase out diesel vehicles.

title: Collocations (combinaciones fijas)
summary: Palabras que van juntas por uso: make a decision, carry out an inspection, meet a deadline, pose a threat, raise awareness, take measures, bear in mind, draw a conclusion, file a complaint, press charges.
examples: The new regulation poses a serious threat to small firms.
Officers carried out a thorough search.

title: Preposiciones dependientes
summary: Adjetivos, verbos y sustantivos que exigen una preposición: comply with, responsible for, in charge of, on behalf of, in accordance with, subject to, prior to, regardless of, consistent with.
examples: All installations must comply with the regulation.
Prior to the audit, records must be updated.

title: Formación de palabras: prefijos negativos
summary: un-, in-, im- (antes de p/m/b), il- (antes de l), ir- (antes de r), dis-, mis- (mal), non-, under-/over-. Ojo: irresponsible, illegible, inadequate, unprecedented, misleading.
examples: The results were inconclusive.
The claim was misleading.

title: Formación de palabras: sufijos
summary: Sustantivos: -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity, -ance/-ence, -ship, -hood. Adjetivos: -able/-ible, -ive, -ous, -al, -ful, -less. Verbos: -ise/-ize, -en, -ify. Adverbios: -ly. Comprueba si el hueco pide plural o negativo.
examples: reliable → reliability
strength → strengthen
compete → competitive / competitiveness

title: Expresiones fijas y frases hechas
summary: Bloques que no admiten cambios: by no means, in the long run, on the verge of, at stake, in the wake of, to the best of my knowledge, take into account, come to terms with, as a matter of course.
examples: In the wake of the accident, procedures were reviewed.
Lives were at stake.

title: Tiempos verbales (perfectos y continuos)
summary: Present perfect para resultados actuales; past perfect para anterioridad en el pasado; future perfect (will have done) para plazos; continuo para acciones en curso o temporales.
examples: By 2030, the plant will have reduced its emissions by half.
When the patrol arrived, the thieves had already left.

title: Oraciones de participio
summary: Reducen subordinadas: Having finished..., Once installed..., Given that..., Not knowing what to do... El sujeto implícito debe coincidir con el de la principal.
examples: Having reviewed the footage, the officers identified the vehicle.
Once installed, the sensors transmit data every second.

title: Referencia y cohesión textual
summary: En gapped text y lectura: pronombres (this, these, such, the former/the latter), sustituciones (do so, one), conectores y repeticiones léxicas enlazan párrafos. Comprueba qué sustantivo retoma cada pronombre.
examples: Such measures, however, proved costly.
The latter option was finally chosen.
